findings.title: Missing thickness and soil class for topsoil removal
findings.message: The long text 'Boden fachgerecht lösen' lacks the mandatory technical specification of the removal thickness (e.g., 20 cm or 30 cm) and the soil class (Bodenklasse 1-3). Without a defined thickness, the quantity of 500 m² is ambiguous regarding the volume of material to be removed, leading to potential disputes over the depth of excavation.
findings.reference: VOB/C DIN 18302 (Earthworks), STLB-Bau standard text requirements
findings.suggestion: Specify the thickness (e.g., 'Oberboden 20 cm stark abtragen') and the soil class (e.g., 'Bodenklasse 1-3'). Example: 'Oberboden (Bodenklasse 1-3) 20 cm stark abtragen und fachgerecht lösen.'

findings.title: Undefined excavation depth and soil class
findings.message: The reference to 'Baugrubenprofil' is insufficient if the profile is not explicitly defined in the text or attached as a binding document. The soil class (Bodenklasse) and the maximum depth are missing. This creates uncertainty about the effort required for excavation and the type of soil handling (e.g., side storage vs. disposal).
findings.suggestion: Define the soil class (e.g., 'Bodenklasse 3-5') and the depth (e.g., 'bis 2.00 m tief'). If the profile is in a separate drawing, reference it explicitly (e.g., 'gemäß Baugrubenprofil, Zeichnung Nr. [X]').

findings.title: Incomplete specification for pipe supply
findings.message: The long text 'PE-HD DN 150 einschließlich' is cut off or incomplete. It does not specify the pressure rating (e.g., PN 10, PN 16), the standard (e.g., DIN 8077/8078), or what 'including' refers to (e.g., including fittings, including installation?). The unit 'm' suggests supply only, but the lack of details makes the scope unclear.
findings.suggestion: Complete the specification: 'PE-HD Rohrleitung DN 150, PN 16, nach DIN 8077/8078 liefern.' Clarify if installation is included or if it is supply only. If supply only, specify the delivery condition (e.g., 'ab Lager' or 'baustellengestellt').

findings.title: Missing installation and backfilling for pipe
findings.message: The position only covers 'supply' (liefern) of the pipe. Installation (Verlegen), backfilling (Rückverfüllen), and compaction are not listed. If these are intended to be part of the work, they are missing special performances (besondere Leistungen) or separate positions. If they are not intended, the scope is limited to material supply, which might be unintended for a construction LV.
findings.suggestion: Add separate positions for 'Rohrleitung verlegen' (install pipe) and 'Rückverfüllen und Verdichten' (backfill and compact), or clarify that this position includes installation if that was the intent.
